85: ### Controls
86: - **`A` / `D` (or Left / Right Arrow)**: **Walk & Run (Free Exploration - DEFAULT)** — Explore the world at your own pace! Samurai Mack stands still in idle stance when keys are released.
87: - **`F`**: **Toggle Auto-Runner Mode** — Switches between default manual Free Exploration and continuous autonomous sprinting platformer mode.
88: - **`M`**: **Mute / Unmute Background Music** — Toggles looping background music (`Quarter_in_the_Slot.mp3`, default 40% volume) with real-time HUD notification.
89: - **Music Volume Slider (`ESC` Pause Menu / `-` & `=`)**: Drag the interactive Pause Menu volume slider (or press `Left`/`Right`, `-`/`=`, or click `[-]`/`[+]`) to adjust BGM volume in **10% increments** (0%–100%, default **40%**).
90: - **`J` / `X` / `Left Mouse Click`**: **Sword Slash Attack** — Swing katana to defeat Bringer of Death (1 hit), Initial Slime (2 hits), and Demon Slime Boss (5 hits)!
91: - **`Right Mouse Click` / `K`**: **Defend / Parry Stance** — Raise katana in defensive guard for up to 1.0s using `Defend_nobg.png`! Absorbs all enemy attacks (Slime, Bringer of Death scythe, Thunder cloud spell, Demon Boss cleave/smash) with a resonant metallic parry clang (`SFX_BLOCK`), floating `[PARRY]` text, and 0.6s grace invulnerability (2.0s cooldown on deflection).
92: - **`Space` / `Esc` / `Enter` (During Intro Splash & Video)**: **Skip Intro Screen & Video** — Instantly advance from the academic course/group intro splash screen or skip the cinematic video directly into gameplay.
93: - **`Left Shift`**: **Dash Movement** — High-speed burst with ghost trail afterimages and spike/hazard invulnerability!
94: - **`Space` / `W` / `Up Arrow`**: Jump across gaps and over spiky traps, or latch on and climb upward inside ladder shafts
95: - **`S` / `Down Arrow`**: Drop down through one-way platforms or descend into underground ladder shafts
96: - **`Esc`**: Open / Close **Pause Menu** (pause physics simulation, inspect stats, adjust BGM slider, restart, or quit)
97: - **`F11`**: **Toggle Fullscreen** — Expands the horizontal field of view across the full screen width with vertical black letterbox borders and zero stretching.
98: - **`B`**: **Cycle Background Scenery** (Silvergrass Field <-> Autumn Foliage <-> Green Forest Foliage <-> Urban Area)
99: - **`N`**: **Fast-Forward Day / Night Cycle** (Instantly advance 90-second half-cycle between Day and Night)
100: - **`T`**: **Open Tutorial Window** — View the comprehensive How-to-Play guide modal dialog during active exploration or inside the Pause Menu.

Loading The Wenderer (WebAssembly)...
Click inside the game window to lock focus | Controls: A/D Move • Space Jump • J Attack • K Defend • ESC Pause
{{{ SCRIPT }}}

@echo off
REM =========================================================================
REM The Wenderer: WebAssembly + WebGL 2 Compilation Script via Emscripten
REM Usage: Run from terminal where emsdk_env.bat has been activated.
REM =========================================================================

echo.
echo =========================================================================
echo Compiling The Wenderer for Web (WebAssembly + WebGL 2) via Emscripten...
echo =========================================================================

if not exist build-web mkdir build-web

call em++ ^
    src/main.cpp ^
    src/Renderer.cpp ^
    src/World.cpp ^
    src/UIManager.cpp ^
    src/LadderScene.cpp ^
    src/SkyFallScene.cpp ^
    src/Audio.cpp ^
    src/VideoPlayer.cpp ^
    -Iinclude ^
    -std=c++17 ^
    -O3 ^
    -s USE_GLFW=3 ^
    -s MIN_WEBGL_VERSION=2 ^
    -s MAX_WEBGL_VERSION=2 ^
    -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 ^
    -s INITIAL_MEMORY=67108864 ^
    -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS="['ccall','cwrap']" ^
    --preload-file assets ^
    --shell-file shell_minimal.html ^
    -o build-web/index.html

if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
    echo.
    echo =========================================================================
    echo [SUCCESS] Web build completed successfully!
    echo Output directory: build-web\
    echo.
    echo To test locally:
    echo   python -m http.server 8080 --directory build-web
    echo Then open: http://localhost:8080
    echo.
    echo To package for itch.io:
    echo   Compress-Archive -Path build-web\* -DestinationPath TheWenderer_Web_itch.zip -Force
    echo =========================================================================
) else (
    echo.
    echo [ERROR] Web build failed with error code %ERRORLEVEL%.
)

# Implementation Plan: Web Port & itch.io Deployment

- **Session**: `11. Web Port & Itch.io Deployment Guide`
- **Target Guide**: [`/doc/WEB_PORT_AND_ITCH_GUIDE.md`](/doc/WEB_PORT_AND_ITCH_GUIDE.md)
- **Target Artifacts**: [`/shell_minimal.html`](/shell_minimal.html), [`/build_web.bat`](/build_web.bat), [`/Makefile`](/Makefile)

---

## 1. Objectives
1. Provide an exhaustive, technically rigorous, step-by-step architectural guide explaining how to turn **The Wenderer** (C++17, GLFW, OpenGL 3.3 Core, GLAD, WinMM/MCI, Windows Media Foundation) into a WebAssembly (Wasm) + WebGL 2.0 browser game.
2. Provide complete instructions on compiling, configuring, testing, packaging, and publishing the game on [itch.io](https://itch.io) as a browser-playable HTML5 title.
3. Supply concrete code modifications (`#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__`) for the main loop, shader adaptation, Web Audio bridge, virtual filesystem, and persistent browser storage.
4. Provide ready-to-run automation scripts (`build_web.bat`, `shell_minimal.html`, `Makefile` targets) to streamline deployment.

---

## 2. Key Architecture Milestones

### Milestone 1: Toolchain & Build System Integration
- Install and configure Emscripten SDK (`emsdk`).
- Create `build_web.bat` with optimized flags (`-O3`, `-sUSE_GLFW=3`, `-sMIN_WEBGL_VERSION=2`, `-sALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1`, `--preload-file assets`).
- Add `web` and `package-web` targets to [`/Makefile`](/Makefile).

### Milestone 2: Main Loop Asynchronous Refactoring
- Decouple the blocking `while (!glfwWindowShouldClose)` desktop loop in [`/src/main.cpp`](/src/main.cpp) into a discrete `mainLoopTick()` function.
- Register `mainLoopTick` with `emscripten_set_main_loop()` when compiling under `__EMSCRIPTEN__`.

### Milestone 3: Graphics & Shader Migration
- WebGL 2.0 (`<GLES3/gl3.h>`) integration in [`/src/Renderer.cpp`](/src/Renderer.cpp) without requiring desktop GLAD.
- Introduce `#version 300 es` shader definitions with `precision highp float;` qualifiers for fragment calculations.

### Milestone 4: Audio & Storage Web Bridges
- Implement lightweight JavaScript bridges via `EM_JS` in [`/src/Audio.cpp`](/src/Audio.cpp) for HTML5 / Web Audio execution.
- Map high score records (`score_record.txt`) to `localStorage` via `EM_JS`.

### Milestone 5: Itch.io Packaging & Deployment
- Supply responsive, pixel-crisp `shell_minimal.html` template.
- Document ZIP packaging rules (`index.html` at root).
- Document itch.io project dashboard configuration (Kind of Project = HTML, Viewport 1024x720, Fullscreen button enabled).

---

## 3. Verification & Compliance
- Ensure all markdown links use absolute root-relative paths (`[/path](/path)`).
- Ensure backward compatibility with native Windows desktop build (`make win`).

22. **Cross-Platform Web Compilation (WebAssembly & WebGL 2.0 via Emscripten) (`v0.8.2`)**:
    - **From OpenGL 3.3 to WebGL 2.0**:
      - Web browsers do not execute native x86 machine code or Desktop OpenGL. Emscripten compiles C++ into **WebAssembly (`.wasm`)** and maps OpenGL API calls to **WebGL 2.0** (`<GLES3/gl3.h>`), which is the browser implementation of OpenGL ES 3.0.
      - Shaders translate cleanly from `#version 330 core` to `#version 300 es` by appending `precision highp float;` for floating-point calculations.
    - **Non-Blocking Browser Event Loop**:
      - While desktop games use a blocking while-loop (`while (!glfwWindowShouldClose)`), browsers require a cooperative event loop driven by `emscripten_set_main_loop(mainLoopTick, 0, 1)`. This delegates frame scheduling to `requestAnimationFrame` at 60 FPS without freezing the web page.
    - **Web Audio & Virtual Asset Pack**:
      - Audio calls use Emscripten's `EM_JS` JavaScript bridge to invoke the browser's HTML5 Audio API.
      - Assets are packaged into a virtual filesystem (`--preload-file assets`), allowing identical C++ asset loading paths (`assets/...`) in browser sandboxes. See [`/doc/WEB_PORT_AND_ITCH_GUIDE.md`](/doc/WEB_PORT_AND_ITCH_GUIDE.md) for full instructions.

# Web Porting & itch.io Online Deployment Guide 🌐🕹️

A comprehensive, production-ready guide has been created in [`/doc/WEB_PORT_AND_ITCH_GUIDE.md`](/doc/WEB_PORT_AND_ITCH_GUIDE.md). It details how to turn **The Wenderer** (C++17, GLFW, Modern OpenGL 3.3 Core, WinMM/MCI, Windows Media Foundation) into a **WebAssembly (`.wasm`)** and **WebGL 2.0** game playable online in modern web browsers and hosted on **itch.io**.

Accompanying build automation scripts and itch.io web templates have also been added to the repository:
- [`/doc/WEB_PORT_AND_ITCH_GUIDE.md`](/doc/WEB_PORT_AND_ITCH_GUIDE.md): The exhaustive, step-by-step technical guide.
- [`/shell_minimal.html`](/shell_minimal.html): Custom dark-themed HTML5 container with crisp pixel-art scaling, loading progress bar, canvas focus management, and itch.io arrow-key scroll suppression.
- [`/build_web.bat`](/build_web.bat): One-click Windows batch compilation script invoking `em++`.
- [`/Makefile`](/Makefile): Updated with `make web` and `make package-web` targets.
- [`/README.md`](/README.md) & [`/doc/changelog.md`](/doc/changelog.md): Synchronized for release `v0.8.2`.

---

## 1. Architectural Summary: The 6 Pillars of Porting to Web

Because *The Wenderer* is a native desktop C++ executable, compiling it for browsers requires addressing 6 core differences:

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                            THE WENDERER ENGINE (C++17)                            |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
|             DESKTOP BUILD               |                WEB BUILD                |
|               (Windows)                 |         (Emscripten / WebAssembly)      |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
| Compiler: g++ / MSVC                    | Compiler: em++ (Emscripten)             |
| Window:   GLFW 3.3 (Desktop Win32)      | Window:   GLFW 3.3 (Emscripten Port)    |
| Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 Core + GLAD        | Graphics: WebGL 2.0 (GLES 3.0 / gl3.h)  |
| Shaders:  #version 330 core             | Shaders:  #version 300 es               |
| Loop:     Blocking while(!glfwClose)    | Loop:     emscripten_set_main_loop()    |
| Audio:    WinMM (MCI mciSendStringA)    | Audio:    Web Audio API / HTML5 Audio   |
| Video:    Media Foundation (mfplat.lib) | Video:    HTML5 <video> / Direct Splash |
| Files:    Direct OS Filesystem          | Files:    MEMFS Virtual Asset Pack      |
| Storage:  score_record.txt (Disk)       | Storage:  Browser localStorage / IDBFS  |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
```

1. **Non-Blocking Asynchronous Main Loop (`src/main.cpp`)**:
   Desktop loops use `while (!glfwWindowShouldClose)`. In a single-threaded browser JavaScript environment, an infinite while-loop halts the DOM and freezes the tab. Using `#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__`, the per-frame tick is refactored into `mainLoopTick()` and registered with `emscripten_set_main_loop(mainLoopTick, 0, 1)`.
2. **WebGL 2.0 & Shader Conversion (`src/Renderer.cpp`)**:
   Desktop OpenGL 3.3 Core maps directly to **WebGL 2.0** (OpenGL ES 3.0). Emscripten provides native `<GLES3/gl3.h>` (eliminating the need for desktop `glad.c`). Shaders use `#version 300 es` with `precision highp float;`.
3. **Cross-Platform Audio Bridge (`src/Audio.cpp`)**:
   Windows Multimedia (`winmm.lib`, `mciSendStringA`) is replaced under `__EMSCRIPTEN__` by lightweight `EM_JS` macros that invoke browser `new Audio(...)` objects with volume control.
4. **Cinematic Video Handling (`src/VideoPlayer.cpp`)**:
   Windows Media Foundation (`mfplat.lib`, `mfreadwrite.lib`) is bypassed on Web, allowing seamless transition from the procedural Modern OpenGL academic splash screen directly into the game while saving 4.8 MB of download size.
5. **Virtual Asset Filesystem (`--preload-file assets`)**:
   Emscripten packages the entire [`assets/`](/assets/) folder into `index.data` and mounts it in memory. All existing C++ paths (`assets/samurai/Run.png`, etc.) load without changes.
6. **High Score Persistence**:
   `score_record.txt` standard file streams are bridged to browser `localStorage` using minimal `EM_JS` helper functions.

---

## 2. Quick Start: Build & Deploy in 4 Steps

### Step 1: Install & Activate the Emscripten SDK (`emsdk`)
Open PowerShell or Terminal:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/emscripten-core/emsdk.git
cd emsdk
./emsdk install latest
./emsdk activate latest
emsdk_env.bat        # On Windows (or: source ./emsdk_env.sh on Linux/macOS)
cd /path/to/CGMLabProject_2DGame
```

### Step 2: Compile the Web Build
Run the provided script or make target:
```cmd
build_web.bat
# Or: make web
```
This produces `build-web/` containing:
- `index.html` (generated from [`shell_minimal.html`](/shell_minimal.html))
- `index.js` (JavaScript glue code)
- `index.wasm` (compiled C++ engine bytecode)
- `index.data` (preloaded asset bundle)

### Step 3: Test Locally via HTTP Server
> [!WARNING]
> Do **not** open `index.html` directly via `file://`. Browsers block WebAssembly and data packages due to CORS security policies.

Launch a quick local server:
```bash
python -m http.server 8080 --directory build-web
```
Navigate to `http://localhost:8080` in your browser. Click the canvas or press `Space` to start the game and initialize audio.

### Step 4: Package & Upload to itch.io
1. Package the output folder into a ZIP file (**`index.html` must reside at the root of the archive**):
   ```cmd
   make package-web
   # Or in PowerShell:
   Compress-Archive -Path build-web/* -DestinationPath TheWenderer_Web_itch.zip -Force
   ```
2. Go to your [itch.io](https://itch.io) Creator Dashboard $\rightarrow$ **Create new project**.
3. Under **Kind of project**, select **HTML** (*"You have a ZIP or HTML file that will be played in the browser"*).
4. Under **Uploads**, upload `TheWenderer_Web_itch.zip` and check:
   ☑ **This file will be played in the browser**
5. Under **Embed options**:
   - Set **Viewport dimensions**: `1024` width $\times$ `720` height.
   - Check ☑ **Enable fullscreen button**.
   - Check ☑ **Automatically start on page load**.
6. Save and view page!

---

## 3. Reference Links
- [`/doc/WEB_PORT_AND_ITCH_GUIDE.md`](/doc/WEB_PORT_AND_ITCH_GUIDE.md): Complete guide with full code snippets, compiler flag breakdowns, and troubleshooting.
- [`/shell_minimal.html`](/shell_minimal.html): HTML5 canvas shell template.
- [`/build_web.bat`](/build_web.bat): Direct Emscripten build batch script.
- [`/doc/changelog.md`](/doc/changelog.md): Release notes for `v0.8.2`.
- [`/doc/prompts/11. Web Port & Itch.io Deployment Guide/summary.md`](/doc/prompts/11.%20Web%20Port%20%26%20Itch.io%20Deployment%20Guide/summary.md): Session 11 summary archive.

## 1. Architectural Summary: The 6 Pillars of Porting to Web

Because *The Wenderer* is a native desktop C++ executable, compiling it for browsers requires addressing 6 core differences:

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                            THE WENDERER ENGINE (C++17)                            |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
|             DESKTOP BUILD               |                WEB BUILD                |
|               (Windows)                 |         (Emscripten / WebAssembly)      |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
| Compiler: g++ / MSVC                    | Compiler: em++ (Emscripten)             |
| Window:   GLFW 3.3 (Desktop Win32)      | Window:   GLFW 3.3 (Emscripten Port)    |
| Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 Core + GLAD        | Graphics: WebGL 2.0 (GLES 3.0 / gl3.h)  |
| Shaders:  #version 330 core             | Shaders:  #version 300 es               |
| Loop:     Blocking while(!glfwClose)    | Loop:     emscripten_set_main_loop()    |
| Audio:    WinMM (MCI mciSendStringA)    | Audio:    Web Audio API / HTML5 Audio   |
| Video:    Media Foundation (mfplat.lib) | Video:    HTML5 <video> / Direct Splash |
| Files:    Direct OS Filesystem          | Files:    MEMFS Virtual Asset Pack      |
| Storage:  score_record.txt (Disk)       | Storage:  Browser localStorage / IDBFS  |
+-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
```

1. **Non-Blocking Asynchronous Main Loop (`src/main.cpp`)**:
   Desktop loops use `while (!glfwWindowShouldClose)`. In a single-threaded browser JavaScript environment, an infinite while-loop halts the DOM and freezes the tab. Using `#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__`, the per-frame tick is refactored into `mainLoopTick()` and registered with `emscripten_set_main_loop(mainLoopTick, 0, 1)`.
2. **WebGL 2.0 & Shader Conversion (`src/Renderer.cpp`)**:
   Desktop OpenGL 3.3 Core maps directly to **WebGL 2.0** (OpenGL ES 3.0). Emscripten provides native `<GLES3/gl3.h>` (eliminating the need for desktop `glad.c`). Shaders use `#version 300 es` with `precision highp float;`.
3. **Cross-Platform Audio Bridge (`src/Audio.cpp`)**:
   Windows Multimedia (`winmm.lib`, `mciSendStringA`) is replaced under `__EMSCRIPTEN__` by lightweight `EM_JS` macros that invoke browser `new Audio(...)` objects with volume control.
4. **Cinematic Video Handling (`src/VideoPlayer.cpp`)**:
   Windows Media Foundation (`mfplat.lib`, `mfreadwrite.lib`) is bypassed on Web, allowing seamless transition from the procedural Modern OpenGL academic splash screen directly into the game while saving 4.8 MB of download size.
5. **Virtual Asset Filesystem (`--preload-file assets`)**:
   Emscripten packages the entire [`assets/`](/assets/) folder into `index.data` and mounts it in memory. All existing C++ paths (`assets/samurai/Run.png`, etc.) load without changes.
6. **High Score Persistence**:
   `score_record.txt` standard file streams are bridged to browser `localStorage` using minimal `EM_JS` helper functions.

## 2. Quick Start: Build & Deploy in 4 Steps

### Step 1: Install & Activate the Emscripten SDK (`emsdk`)
Open PowerShell or Terminal:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/emscripten-core/emsdk.git
cd emsdk
./emsdk install latest
./emsdk activate latest
emsdk_env.bat        # On Windows (or: source ./emsdk_env.sh on Linux/macOS)
cd /path/to/CGMLabProject_2DGame
```

### Step 2: Compile the Web Build
Run the provided script or make target:
```cmd
build_web.bat
# Or: make web
```
This produces `build-web/` containing:
- `index.html` (generated from [`shell_minimal.html`](/shell_minimal.html))
- `index.js` (JavaScript glue code)
- `index.wasm` (compiled C++ engine bytecode)
- `index.data` (preloaded asset bundle)

### Step 3: Test Locally via HTTP Server
> [!WARNING]
> Do **not** open `index.html` directly via `file://`. Browsers block WebAssembly and data packages due to CORS security policies.

Launch a quick local server:
```bash
python -m http.server 8080 --directory build-web
```
Navigate to `http://localhost:8080` in your browser. Click the canvas or press `Space` to start the game and initialize audio.

### Step 4: Package & Upload to itch.io
1. Package the output folder into a ZIP file (**`index.html` must reside at the root of the archive**):
   ```cmd
   make package-web
   # Or in PowerShell:
   Compress-Archive -Path build-web/* -DestinationPath TheWenderer_Web_itch.zip -Force
   ```
2. Go to your [itch.io](https://itch.io) Creator Dashboard $\rightarrow$ **Create new project**.
3. Under **Kind of project**, select **HTML** (*"You have a ZIP or HTML file that will be played in the browser"*).
4. Under **Uploads**, upload `TheWenderer_Web_itch.zip` and check:
   ☑ **This file will be played in the browser**
5. Under **Embed options**:
   - Set **Viewport dimensions**: `1024` width $\times$ `720` height.
   - Check ☑ **Enable fullscreen button**.
   - Check ☑ **Automatically start on page load**.
6. Save and view page!

# =========================================================================
# The Wenderer: Complete Web Build & Itch.io Packaging Script
# Compiles C++ to WebAssembly + WebGL 2.0 and packages itch.io release
# =========================================================================

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$OutputDir = "d:\GitHub\UITS\CGMLabProject_2DGame\TheWenderer_Web"
$CacheDir = "d:\GitHub\UITS\CGMLabProject_2DGame\build-web\em_cache"

Write-Host "=========================================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Compiling The Wenderer for Web (WebAssembly + WebGL 2.0)..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "=========================================================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# 1. Ensure Directories Exist
if (!(Test-Path $OutputDir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $OutputDir -Force | Out-Null
}
if (!(Test-Path $CacheDir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $CacheDir -Force | Out-Null
}

# 2. Configure Emscripten Environment
$env:EM_CACHE = $CacheDir
$env:PATH = "C:\emsdk;C:\emsdk\upstream\emscripten;C:\emsdk\node\24.19.0_64bit;C:\emsdk\python\3.13.3_64bit;$env:PATH"
$env:EMSDK = "C:/emsdk"
$env:EMSDK_NODE = "C:\emsdk\node\24.19.0_64bit\node.exe"
$env:EMSDK_PYTHON = "C:\emsdk\python\3.13.3_64bit\python.exe"

$python = "C:\emsdk\python\3.13.3_64bit\python.exe"
$empp = "C:\emsdk\upstream\emscripten\em++.py"

$sourceFiles = @(
    "src/main.cpp",
    "src/Renderer.cpp",
    "src/World.cpp",
    "src/UIManager.cpp",
    "src/LadderScene.cpp",
    "src/SkyFallScene.cpp",
    "src/Audio.cpp",
    "src/VideoPlayer.cpp"
)

$targetHtml = "$OutputDir/index.html"

# Remove old build artifacts in output directory (except .zip if any)
Remove-Item -Path "$OutputDir/index.*" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

Write-Host "Invoking em++ with optimizations (-O3, WebGL 2.0, GLFW 3)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow

& $python $empp `
    $sourceFiles `
    -Iinclude `
    -std=c++17 `
    -O3 `
    -s USE_GLFW=3 `
    -s MIN_WEBGL_VERSION=2 `
    -s MAX_WEBGL_VERSION=2 `
    -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 `
    -s INITIAL_MEMORY=67108864 `
    --preload-file assets `
    --shell-file shell_minimal.html `
    -o $targetHtml

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Error "Emscripten compilation failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE."
    exit $LASTEXITCODE
}

Write-Host "[SUCCESS] WebAssembly and WebGL 2.0 build generated!" -ForegroundColor Green

# 3. Create itch.io Distribution ZIP
$zipPath = "$OutputDir/TheWenderer_Web_itch.zip"
if (Test-Path $zipPath) {
    Remove-Item $zipPath -Force
}

Write-Host "Creating itch.io distribution ZIP: $zipPath..." -ForegroundColor Yellow

$itemsToZip = Get-ChildItem -Path $OutputDir -Exclude "*.zip"
Compress-Archive -Path $itemsToZip.FullName -DestinationPath $zipPath -Force

Write-Host "=========================================================================" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "BUILD COMPLETE!" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Web build directory: $OutputDir" -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "itch.io ZIP package: $zipPath" -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "=========================================================================" -ForegroundColor Green

546: #### Breakdown of Important `em++` Compiler Flags:
547: - `-std=c++17`: Matches the desktop standard.
548: - `-O3`: Maximum speed and size optimization for WebAssembly bytecode.
549: - `-s USE_GLFW=3`: Links Emscripten's built-in GLFW 3 emulation layer.
550: - `-s MIN_WEBGL_VERSION=2 -s MAX_WEBGL_VERSION=2`: Targets WebGL 2.0 (OpenGL ES 3.0), matching the modern shaders.
551: - `-s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1`: Permits the WebAssembly heap to expand dynamically as textures and chunk buffers are allocated.
552: - `-s INITIAL_MEMORY=67108864`: Allocates an initial 64MB memory pool to prevent reallocations on game startup.
553: - `--preload-file assets`: Automatically packages the entire `assets/` folder into `index.data`.
554: - `--shell-file shell_minimal.html`: Embeds the game inside our custom, clean itch.io-ready HTML template.
555: 
556: ---
557: 
558: ### Method B: CMake with `emcmake`
559: 
560: If using CMake, configure `CMakeLists.txt` to detect Emscripten:
561: 
562: ```cmake
563: if(EMSCRIPTEN)
564:     set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -O3 -s USE_GLFW=3 -s MIN_WEBGL_VERSION=2 -s MAX_WEBGL_VERSION=2 -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1")
565:     set(CMAKE_EXECUTABLE_SUFFIX ".html")
566:     
567:     # Exclude Windows-specific static libraries
568:     target_link_libraries(TheWenderer "")
569:     set_target_properties(TheWenderer PROPERTIES LINK_FLAGS "--preload-file ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets@assets --shell-file ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/shell_minimal.html")
570: else()
571:     # Native Desktop Linkage
572:     target_link_libraries(TheWenderer glfw3 opengl32 gdi32 winmm mfplat mfreadwrite mfuuid ole32)
573: endif()
574: ```
575: 
576: Run the build commands:
577: ```bash
578: emcmake cmake -B build-web
579: cmake --build build-web --config Release
580: ```
581: 
582: ---
583: 
584: ### Method C: Makefile Target Integration
585: 
586: Add a `web` target directly to [`/Makefile`](/Makefile):
587: 
588: ```makefile
589: web:
590: 	@if not exist build-web mkdir build-web
591: 	em++ src/main.cpp src/Renderer.cpp src/World.cpp src/UIManager.cpp src/LadderScene.cpp src/SkyFallScene.cpp src/Audio.cpp src/VideoPlayer.cpp \
592: 		-Iinclude -std=c++17 -O3 -s USE_GLFW=3 -s MIN_WEBGL_VERSION=2 -s MAX_WEBGL_VERSION=2 \
593: 		-s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 --preload-file assets --shell-file shell_minimal.html \
594: 		-o build-web/index.html
595: ```

## 8. Publishing on itch.io (Complete Step-by-Step Walkthrough)

Deploying *The Wenderer* to itch.io takes only a few minutes.

### 8.1 Preparing the itch.io ZIP Package

Itch.io requires HTML5 games to be submitted as a single `.zip` archive. **Crucially, `index.html` must be placed directly at the root of the `.zip` file** (not nested inside a folder!).

The build script [`/build_web.ps1`](/build_web.ps1) and [`/Makefile`](/Makefile) (`make web` or `make package-web`) automatically compiles the code and generates the upload-ready ZIP inside [`/TheWenderer_Web/`](/TheWenderer_Web/):

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File build_web.ps1
```

The resulting zip archive is generated directly at [`/TheWenderer_Web/TheWenderer_Web_itch.zip`](/TheWenderer_Web/TheWenderer_Web_itch.zip) and contains:
```
TheWenderer_Web_itch.zip
├── index.html
├── index.js
├── index.wasm
└── index.data
```

   - Factored initialization into `initializeGame(window)` and the per-frame game simulation into `mainLoopIteration()`.

   - Replaced desktop GLAD loader with native Emscripten `<GLES3/gl3.h>` symbols.

   - Bridged `score_record.txt` file reads and writes to browser `localStorage` (`thewenderer_highest` and `thewenderer_prev`).

---

Due to browser Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) security rules, WebAssembly and data packages cannot be loaded via `file://`. Test locally using a lightweight HTTP server:

```powershell
python -m http.server 8080 --directory TheWenderer_Web
```
Then navigate to: **`http://localhost:8080`** in Chrome, Firefox, Edge, or Safari. Click the canvas or press `Space` to initiate audio and start playing!

## Overview
This is the minimal "Hello World" of WebGL 2.0 and WebAssembly using C++ and Emscripten. It demonstrates:
- GLFW3 window and context creation in a browser canvas.

- Dynamic color animation clearing the framebuffer every frame.

```cmd
build.bat
```
or with Make:
```bash
make run
```
This compiles `src/main.cpp` into `dist/index.html` and launches a local web server at `http://localhost:8080`.

thinking: Initial focus is on constructing a WebGL environment test script. The script's purpose is to verify the presence and correct setup of essential development tools: Git, Python, Node.js, and Emscripten. The script will also check for the existence and initialization of the Emscripten SDK directory and perform a quick compilation test using a small C++ program.

The plan is to create installation and uninstallation scripts for WebGL. Examining an existing OpenGL installation script reveals its use of self-elevation to gain administrative privileges. This approach will be adapted for the WebGL scripts.


The WebGL installation script requires administrator privileges, so the VBScript elevation snippet will be used, mirroring the OpenGL script. The script checks for Git installation; if absent, it downloads and extracts the emsdk zip via PowerShell, then installs and activates the latest emsdk version, and sets the `EM_CACHE` variable. The machine PATH will be updated with emsdk paths. The uninstallation script will also require administrator privileges to remove the Emscripten paths from the PATH variables and delete the `C:\emsdk` directory if selected.

args.Content:
@echo off
setlocal enabledelayedexpansion
title WebGL 2.0 / Emscripten One-Click Setup (Admin)

:: ==============================================================================
:: Self-Elevation to Administrator
:: ==============================================================================
>nul 2>&1 "%SYSTEMROOT%\system32\cacls.exe" "%SYSTEMROOT%\system32\config\system"
if '%errorlevel%' NEQ '0' (
    echo [INFO] Requesting Administrative Privileges...
    goto UACPrompt
) else ( goto gotAdmin )

:UACPrompt
    echo Set UAC = CreateObject^("Shell.Application"^) > "%temp%\getadmin_webgl.vbs"
    set params=%*
    echo UAC.ShellExecute "cmd.exe", "/c """"%~s0"" %params%""", "", "runas", 1 >> "%temp%\getadmin_webgl.vbs"
    "%temp%\getadmin_webgl.vbs"
    del "%temp%\getadmin_webgl.vbs"
    exit /B

:gotAdmin
    pushd "%CD%"
    CD /D "%~dp0"

echo ==============================================================================
echo                 WebGL 2.0 / WebAssembly Toolchain Installer
echo                 (Emscripten SDK + LLVM Wasm + Node + Python)
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
echo Target Installation Directory: C:\emsdk
echo.

set "EMSDK_DIR=C:\emsdk"

:: Step 1: Check or Clone emsdk
if exist "%EMSDK_DIR%\emsdk.bat" (
    echo [1/4] Emscripten SDK repository detected at %EMSDK_DIR%. Updating...
    pushd "%EMSDK_DIR%"
    call git pull origin main >nul 2>nul
    popd
) else (
    echo [1/4] Cloning Emscripten SDK repository to %EMSDK_DIR%...
    where git >nul 2>nul
    if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 (
        git clone https://github.com/emscripten-core/emsdk.git "%EMSDK_DIR%"
    ) else (
        echo [INFO] Git not found. Downloading Emscripten SDK archive via PowerShell...
        powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command ^
            "$zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'emsdk-main.zip'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/emscripten-core/emsdk/archive/refs/heads/main.zip' -OutFile $zip; Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $env:TEMP -Force; Move-Item -Path (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'emsdk-main') -Destination 'C:\emsdk' -Force; Remove-Item $zip -Force"
    )
)

if not exist "%EMSDK_DIR%\emsdk.bat" (
    echo.
    echo [ERROR] Failed to obtain Emscripten SDK at %EMSDK_DIR%.
    echo Please ensure you have internet access and try again.
    pause
    exit /b 1
)

:: Step 2: Install latest tools (LLVM backend, clang, binaryen, node)
echo.
echo [2/4] Installing latest Emscripten toolchain (this may take a few minutes)...
pushd "%EMSDK_DIR%"
call emsdk.bat install latest
if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 (
    echo [ERROR] emsdk install failed!
    popd
    pause
    exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%
)

:: Step 3: Activate latest tools permanently
echo.
echo [3/4] Activating latest Emscripten SDK and writing environment...
call emsdk.bat activate latest --permanent
popd

:: Step 4: Configure Machine Environment Variables & System PATH
echo.
echo [4/4] Registering Emscripten to System Environment & Setting Cache...
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command ^
    "$emsdk = 'C:\emsdk'; " ^
    "$upstream = 'C:\emsdk\upstream\emscripten'; " ^
    "[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('EMSDK', $emsdk, 'Machine'); " ^
    "[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('EM_CACHE', 'C:\emsdk\cache', 'Machine'); " ^
    "$oldPath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'Machine'); " ^
    "$paths = $oldPath -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' }; " ^
    "if ($paths -notcontains $emsdk) { $paths += $emsdk }; " ^
    "if ($paths -notcontains $upstream) { $paths += $upstream }; " ^
    "$newPath = ($paths -join ';'); " ^
    "[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', $newPath, 'Machine'); " ^
    "Write-Host '[OK] System environment variables and PATH configured successfully.'"

echo.
echo ==============================================================================
echo [SUCCESS] WebGL 2.0 / WebAssembly Environment Successfully Installed!
echo.
echo Installed Components:
echo   - Emscripten Compiler (emcc, em++)
echo   - LLVM & Clang WebAssembly Backend
echo   - Binaryen WebAssembly Optimizer
echo   - Embedded Node.js runtime
echo   - Local HTTP CORS bypass tools
echo.
echo Next Steps:
echo   1. Run 'test_webgl_env.bat' to verify your compiler.
echo   2. Open 'PROJECTS\create_webgl_project.bat' to start a new project.
echo   3. Explore ready-to-run demos in 'sample_projects\'.
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
pause

@echo off
setlocal enabledelayedexpansion
title WebGL / Emscripten Uninstaller (Admin)

:: Self-Elevation to Administrator
>nul 2>&1 "%SYSTEMROOT%\system32\cacls.exe" "%SYSTEMROOT%\system32\config\system"
if '%errorlevel%' NEQ '0' (
    echo [INFO] Requesting Administrative Privileges...
    goto UACPrompt
) else ( goto gotAdmin )

:UACPrompt
    echo Set UAC = CreateObject^("Shell.Application"^) > "%temp%\getadmin_uninst.vbs"
    set params=%*
    echo UAC.ShellExecute "cmd.exe", "/c """"%~s0"" %params%""", "", "runas", 1 >> "%temp%\getadmin_uninst.vbs"
    "%temp%\getadmin_uninst.vbs"
    del "%temp%\getadmin_uninst.vbs"
    exit /B

:gotAdmin
    pushd "%CD%"
    CD /D "%~dp0"

echo ==============================================================================
echo               WebGL / Emscripten Toolchain Uninstaller
echo ==============================================================================
echo.

set /p CONFIRM="Are you sure you want to uninstall Emscripten and remove it from PATH? (y/n): "
if /i not "%CONFIRM%"=="y" (
    echo Operation cancelled by user.
    pause
    exit /b 0
)

echo.
echo [1/2] Removing Emscripten paths from System and User PATH...
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command ^
    "$cleanTarget = { param($target) " ^
    "  $oldPath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', $target); " ^
    "  if ($oldPath) { " ^
    "    $paths = $oldPath -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' -and $_ -notlike '*emsdk*' }; " ^
    "    $newPath = ($paths -join ';'); " ^
    "    [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', $newPath, $target); " ^
    "  } " ^
    "}; " ^
    "& $cleanTarget 'Machine'; " ^
    "& $cleanTarget 'User'; " ^
    "[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('EMSDK', $null, 'Machine'); " ^
    "[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('EM_CACHE', $null, 'Machine'); " ^
    "[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('EMSDK', $null, 'User'); " ^
    "[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('EM_CACHE', $null, 'User'); " ^
    "Write-Host '[OK] Removed EMSDK variables and PATH entries.'"

echo.
echo [2/2] Removing Emscripten files from disk...
if exist "C:\emsdk" (
    set /p DEL_FILES="Delete toolchain files at 'C:\emsdk'? (y/n) [default: y]: "
    if "%DEL_FILES%"=="" set DEL_FILES=y
    if /i "%DEL_FILES%"=="y" (
        echo Deleting C:\emsdk (this may take a minute)...
        rmdir /s /q "C:\emsdk"
        if exist "C:\emsdk" (
            echo [WARN] Some locked files could not be deleted immediately.
        ) else (
            echo [OK] C:\emsdk successfully deleted.
        )
    ) else (
        echo Preserving C:\emsdk directory on disk.
    )
)

echo.
echo ==============================================================================
echo [SUCCESS] WebGL / Emscripten environment uninstalled cleanly.
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
pause

# WebGL 2.0 & WebAssembly (C++ / Emscripten) 1-Click Setup & Automation

An automated setup package and comprehensive technical toolkit for developing **WebGL 2.0 and WebAssembly applications in C++** on Windows environments (Windows 10 / 11 64-Bit). Automates Emscripten SDK (`emsdk`) deployment, LLVM & Clang WebAssembly compiler toolchain installation, safe Windows System `PATH` configuration, local CORS-bypassing HTTP servers, boilerplate project generators, and turnkey sample labs.

Build your C++ graphics applications and games once, and publish directly to the web, browser canvases, or **itch.io**!

---

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 📖 **Full Technical & Troubleshooting Guide Available**  
> For in-depth explanations of WebGL 2.0 architecture, WebAssembly memory pipelines, Web Audio JavaScript bridges, itch.io packaging, and CORS security:  
> 👉 **[Read the complete technical guide in guide.md](guide.md)**

---

## ⚡ Quick Start (Automated Setup)

### 1. Clone or Download the Repository

- **Clone with Git:**
  ```bash
  git clone <YOUR_REPOSITORY_URL>/webgl_setup_script.git
  cd webgl_setup_script
  ```

---

### 2. Run the Automated Installer

1. Right-click **`install_webgl_admin.bat`** and select **Run as Administrator** (or double-click to run with automatic UAC self-elevation).
2. The script executes the automated 4-step setup workflow:
   - **[1/4] Emscripten SDK Detection & Download**: Clones or downloads `emsdk` directly into `C:\emsdk`.
   - **[2/4] Toolchain Provisioning**: Installs the latest Clang/LLVM WebAssembly compiler backend, Binaryen optimizer, and Node.js runtime.
   - **[3/4] Toolchain Activation**: Permanently configures SDK profiles.
   - **[4/4] Environment & PATH Registration**: Registers `C:\emsdk`, `C:\emsdk\upstream\emscripten`, and localizes `EM_CACHE` to `C:\emsdk\cache` to prevent Windows cross-drive python path bugs.

---

### 3. Verify the Environment

Run **`test_webgl_env.bat`** (no administrator privileges needed):
- Tests Python, Node.js, and Git.
- Validates `em++` compiler availability.
- Performs an end-to-end compilation test of a live WebAssembly bundle to ensure LLVM and Binaryen function without issues.

---

### 4. Create a New WebGL Project or Run Demos

- **Create a New Project:**
  Double-click `PROJECTS\create_webgl_project.bat`. Enter a project name (e.g. `MyWebGLGame`). The scaffolder creates a complete project folder with pre-configured `src/main.cpp`, `Common.h`, responsive `shell_minimal.html`, `Makefile`, and `build.bat`.

- **Run Sample Demos:**
  Navigate into any directory inside `sample_projects/` and double-click `build.bat`:
  - **`Lab0_WebGL_ClearScreen`**: Minimal WebGL 2.0 clear screen and dynamic color cycle.
  - **`Lab1_WebGL_Triangle`**: Modern WebGL 2.0 RGB triangle using GLSL ES 3.00, VAO, and VBO.
  - **`Lab2_WebGL_2D_Game_Sprite`**: 2D interactive player physics, keyboard controls, Web Audio tone synthesis via `EM_JS`, and `--preload-file assets` packaging.

---

## 📁 Repository Directory Structure

```plaintext
webgl_setup_script/
├── install_webgl_admin.bat        # 1-Click self-elevating setup script
├── uninstall_webgl_admin.bat      # Clean uninstaller (removes PATH & toolchain)
├── test_webgl_env.bat             # Diagnostic tool for compiler & environment
├── README.md                      # Overview & Quick Start guide
├── guide.md                       # Comprehensive WebGL & Emscripten manual
│
├── Dependencies/
│   ├── server/
│   │   └── run_local_server.bat   # 1-Click local HTTP preview server (CORS bypass)
│   └── template/
│       ├── include/
│       │   └── Common.h           # Unified header for GLES3, GLFW3, and WebAssembly
│       ├── src/
│       │   └── main.cpp           # Standard boilerplate WebGL 2.0 entry point
│       ├── shell_minimal.html     # Responsive HTML5 canvas & loader template
│       ├── Makefile               # GNU Make build script
│       └── build.bat              # Turnkey Windows build and preview script
│
├── PROJECTS/
│   └── create_webgl_project.bat   # Interactive project scaffolder
│
└── sample_projects/
    ├── Lab0_WebGL_ClearScreen/    # Minimal clear screen demo
    ├── Lab1_WebGL_Triangle/       # Modern RGB triangle (VAO/VBO/GLSL 3.00 ES)
    └── Lab2_WebGL_2D_Game_Sprite/ # 2D game sprite, Web Audio, asset packaging
```

---

## 🌐 Deploying to itch.io (Web Playable Game)

To make your game playable directly in web browsers on itch.io:

1. In your project folder, compile your game:
   ```cmd
   build.bat
   ```
2. Your build artifacts will be created in `dist/`:
   - `index.html`
   - `index.js`
   - `index.wasm`
   - `index.data` (if assets are bundled)
3. Select all files **inside** `dist/` and compress them directly into a `.zip` archive (ensure `index.html` is at the root of the zip, not nested in a subfolder).
4. On itch.io:
   - Create a new project.
   - Set **Kind of project** to **HTML**.
   - Upload your `.zip` and check **"This file will be played in the browser"**.
   - Recommended Viewport dimensions: **800 x 600** (or your canvas dimensions). Check **"Enable fullscreen button"**.

---

## 🧹 Clean Uninstallation

If you ever wish to remove the WebGL toolchain:
1. Right-click **`uninstall_webgl_admin.bat`** and select **Run as Administrator**.
2. The uninstaller removes `EMSDK` environment variables and cleanly purges Emscripten entries from Windows System `PATH`.
3. Confirms before optionally deleting `C:\emsdk` from disk.

# Comprehensive WebGL 2.0 & WebAssembly Development Guide

A complete technical manual for compiling, running, and publishing modern C++ graphics applications and games to the web using **WebGL 2.0**, **WebAssembly (WASM)**, and the **Emscripten SDK**.

---

## Table of Contents
1. [Desktop OpenGL vs. WebGL 2.0 & WebAssembly](#1-desktop-opengl-vs-webgl-20--webassembly)
2. [The Browser Execution Model & Non-Blocking Loops](#2-the-browser-execution-model--non-blocking-loops)
3. [The Emscripten Toolchain Architecture](#3-the-emscripten-toolchain-architecture)
4. [Shader Language Differences (Desktop GLSL vs. GLSL ES 3.00)](#4-shader-language-differences-desktop-glsl-vs-glsl-es-300)
5. [Asset Packaging & Virtual File Systems (MEMFS)](#5-asset-packaging--virtual-file-systems-memfs)
6. [Web Audio & Browser Autoplay Policies](#6-web-audio--browser-autoplay-policies)
7. [Local Testing & The CORS Security Constraint](#7-local-testing--the-cors-security-constraint)
8. [Publishing to itch.io (Step-by-Step)](#8-publishing-to-itchio-step-by-step)
9. [Windows Pitfalls & Troubleshooting Matrix](#9-windows-pitfalls--troubleshooting-matrix)

---

## 1. Desktop OpenGL vs. WebGL 2.0 & WebAssembly

When developing in C++, desktop graphics and web graphics share the conceptual state machine of OpenGL, but differ substantially in their platform architectures:

| Architectural Component | Desktop Modern OpenGL (3.3 Core) | WebGL 2.0 / WebAssembly |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Binary Output** | Native x86_64 `.exe` machine code | Portable `.wasm` bytecode + `.js` runtime glue |
| **Graphics API Specification** | OpenGL 3.3 Core Profile | OpenGL ES 3.0 (WebGL 2.0) |
| **Display Surface** | OS Window (Win32 / X11 / Cocoa via GLFW) | HTML5 `<canvas>` element |
| **Shader Directive** | `#version 330 core` | `#version 300 es` |
| **Float Precision Qualifiers** | Optional / Ignored by desktop drivers | **Mandatory** in Fragment Shaders (`precision mediump float;`) |
| **Main Loop Model** | Blocking `while (!glfwWindowShouldClose())` | Non-blocking callback via `emscripten_set_main_loop()` |
| **File I/O** | Native OS filesystem (`fopen`, `std::ifstream`) | In-memory virtual filesystem (MEMFS) via `--preload-file` |
| **Audio Pipeline** | DirectSound, XAudio2, ALSA, PulseAudio | Web Audio API (`AudioContext`) |

---

## 2. The Browser Execution Model & Non-Blocking Loops

On desktop systems, your application thread owns the CPU core and can block indefinitely in a loop:
```cpp
// Desktop OpenGL Pattern (DO NOT USE IN BROWSER)
while (!glfwWindowShouldClose(window)) {
    processInput();
    render();
    glfwSwapBuffers(window);
    glfwPollEvents();
}
```

In a web browser, JavaScript and the DOM run on a **single unified UI thread**. If a C++ WebAssembly module enters an infinite loop, it completely locks the browser tab, preventing user input, window resizing, rendering, and garbage collection. The browser will flag the page as "Unresponsive" and terminate the tab.

### The Solution: `emscripten_set_main_loop`
Emscripten bridges the C++ main loop with the browser's native `window.requestAnimationFrame()` mechanism:

```cpp
#if defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__)
#include <emscripten.h>

void mainLoopIteration() {
    processInput();
    render();
    glfwSwapBuffers(window);
    glfwPollEvents();
}

int main() {
    initWindowAndGL();
    // 0 fps = bind to requestAnimationFrame (matches monitor refresh rate, e.g. 60Hz/144Hz)
    // 1 simulate_infinite_loop = safely unwind stack
    emscripten_set_main_loop(mainLoopIteration, 0, 1);
    return 0;
}
#endif
```

---

## 3. The Emscripten Toolchain Architecture

Emscripten operates as a complete cross-compiler pipeline:
1. **Frontend (`clang++`)**: Parses standard C++17/20 code and headers into LLVM Intermediate Representation (LLVM IR).
2. **Optimizer & Codegen (`llc` / `lld`)**: Transforms LLVM IR into WebAssembly binary modules (`.wasm`).
3. **Binaryen (`wasm-opt`)**: Optimizes the WebAssembly binary, performing dead-code stripping, function inlining, and memory layout optimization.
4. **JavaScript Glue (`index.js`)**: Provides POSIX emulation, memory management (`Module.HEAPU8`), WebGL context bridging, and canvas event listeners.
5. **HTML Shell (`index.html`)**: Embeds the canvas, status indicators, and boots the runtime.

```plaintext
[ C++ Source Files (.cpp) ]
            │
            ▼
    [ Clang++ / LLVM ]  ───►  [ LLVM IR Bitcode ]
            │
            ▼
     [ LLD Linker ]     ───►  [ Unoptimized .wasm ]
            │
            ▼
  [ Binaryen (wasm-opt) ] ───►  [ Optimized index.wasm ]
            │
            ▼
   +─────────────────────────────────────────────+
   │ Final Web Bundle:                           │
   │  - index.html   (DOM & Canvas Shell)        │
   │  - index.js     (Emscripten Runtime Glue)   │
   │  - index.wasm   (Compiled WebAssembly Code) │
   │  - index.data   (Packaged Asset Filesystem) │
   +─────────────────────────────────────────────+
```

---

## 4. Shader Language Differences (Desktop GLSL vs. GLSL ES 3.00)

WebGL 2.0 implements the **OpenGL ES 3.0** specification. Shaders written for desktop OpenGL 3.3 Core must be updated as follows:

### 1. Version Header
- Desktop: `#version 330 core`
- WebGL 2.0: `#version 300 es`

### 2. Mandatory Precision Qualifiers
In desktop GLSL, floating point precision defaults to 32-bit `highp`. In OpenGL ES / WebGL 2.0 fragment shaders, **there is no default float precision**. Omitting the precision qualifier causes an immediate compile error:

```glsl
#version 300 es
// MANDATORY for WebGL 2.0 Fragment Shaders:
precision mediump float; // or precision highp float;

in vec3 vColor;
out vec4 FragColor;

void main() {
    FragColor = vec4(vColor, 1.0);
}
```

---

## 5. Asset Packaging & Virtual File Systems (MEMFS)

WebAssembly runs inside an isolated browser sandbox with no direct access to the user's hard drive. Standard C runtime calls like `fopen("assets/player.png", "rb")` fail unless the files are mapped into Emscripten's virtual filesystem (MEMFS).

### Preloading Assets
Add `--preload-file assets` to your `em++` compiler command:
```bash
em++ src/main.cpp -O2 -s USE_GLFW=3 -s FULL_ES3=1 -s USE_WEBGL2=1 \
     --preload-file assets \
     --shell-file shell_minimal.html \
     -o dist/index.html
```

This generates `dist/index.data` containing your assets. When the page loads, Emscripten automatically downloads `index.data`, populates the virtual in-memory filesystem, and allows standard C/C++ file routines (`fopen`, `std::ifstream`, `stbi_load`) to open `"assets/player.png"` transparently.

---

## 6. Web Audio & Browser Autoplay Policies

Desktop games initialize sound drivers on startup. Web browsers, however, enforce a strict **User Gesture Autoplay Policy**: an `AudioContext` cannot produce audio until the user has interacted with the webpage (e.g. by clicking, pressing a key, or tapping the screen).

### The Lightweight Web Audio Bridge (`EM_JS`)
Instead of linking bulky audio libraries, you can directly synthesize or play audio via HTML5 Web Audio using Emscripten's `EM_JS` macro:

```cpp
#if defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__)
#include <emscripten.h>

EM_JS(void, playRetroTone, (float frequency, float duration), {
    try {
        var AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        if (!window._gameAudioContext) {
            window._gameAudioContext = new AudioCtx();
        }
        var ctx = window._gameAudioContext;
        if (ctx.state === 'suspended') {
            ctx.resume(); // Automatically unlocks on first player input
        }
        var osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        var gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, ctx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, ctx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + duration);
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.start();
        osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + duration);
    } catch(e) {
        console.warn('Audio playback error:', e);
    }
});
#endif
```

---

## 7. Local Testing & The CORS Security Constraint

If you double-click `dist/index.html` directly in Windows Explorer, your browser opens it using the `file://` protocol (`file:///C:/path/dist/index.html`).

Modern browsers block WebAssembly loading and `fetch()` requests on the `file://` protocol due to **CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing)** security restrictions. The browser console will display:
```plaintext
Access to fetch at 'file:///.../index.wasm' from origin 'null' has been blocked by CORS policy.
Failed to load resource: net::ERR_FAILED
```

### How to Preview Locally:
Always serve the files through a local HTTP server. You can:
1. Double-click **`Dependencies\server\run_local_server.bat`**, or
2. Run from your project directory:
   ```cmd
   python -m http.server 8080 --directory dist
   ```
3. Open `http://localhost:8080` in Chrome, Firefox, or Edge.

---

## 8. Publishing to itch.io (Step-by-Step)

Publishing a WebGL/Wasm game to **itch.io** takes under 2 minutes:

1. **Build Your Game**:
   In your project root, run `build.bat` to produce the `dist/` directory.
2. **Package the Archive**:
   - Open `dist/`.
   - Select all files (`index.html`, `index.js`, `index.wasm`, and optionally `index.data`).
   - Right-click ➔ **Compress to ZIP file**.
   - **Crucial Rule**: `index.html` must sit directly in the root of the `.zip` archive, NOT inside a subfolder!
3. **Upload to itch.io**:
   - Go to your itch.io dashboard and click **Create new project**.
   - Under **Classification**, select **Games**.
   - Under **Kind of project**, choose **HTML** (*You have a ZIP or HTML file that will be played in the browser*).
   - Scroll down to **Uploads** and click **Upload files**. Select your `.zip`.
   - Check the box **"This file will be played in the browser"**.
   - Under **Embed options**:
     - Set viewport dimensions (e.g. `800` width, `600` height, or your custom resolution).
     - Check **"Enable fullscreen button"**.
     - Check **"Automatically start on page load"**.
   - Save and set visibility to **Public** or **Restricted** (for playtesting).

---

## 9. Windows Pitfalls & Troubleshooting Matrix

### 1. Cross-Drive Python Path Bug in Emscripten
- **Symptom**: `ValueError: path is on mount 'C:', start on mount 'D:'` during compilation.
- **Root Cause**: Emscripten's internal cache defaults to the user directory (`C:\Users\...`). When compiling a project on drive `D:`, Python's `os.path.relpath()` fails between different Windows drive letters.
- **Fix**: The installer automatically sets `EM_CACHE=C:\emsdk\cache` as a System Environment Variable so all internal cache paths share drive `C:`.

### 2. Out of Memory During Execution
- **Symptom**: `RuntimeError: memory access out of bounds` or `Cannot enlarge memory arrays`.
- **Root Cause**: By default, Emscripten allocates a fixed 16MB WebAssembly heap.
- **Fix**: Always include `-s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1` in your compiler flags so WebAssembly can dynamically expand its heap to accommodate larger textures and game levels.

### 3. Missing `make` Command
- **Symptom**: `'make' is not recognized as an internal or external command`.
- **Fix**: You do not need `make`. Simply run `build.bat`, which invokes `em++` directly. If you prefer `make`, install `mingw32-make` or run within an MSYS2 shell using `emmake make`.

# WebGL 2.0 & WebAssembly Setup Package: `webgl_setup_script`

The standalone setup package has been created in [`webgl_setup_script/`](webgl_setup_script/) and added to [`.gitignore`](/.gitignore), ready to be initialized as its own independent Git repository.

---

## 1. Do WebGL Applications Require Installation?

### For Players / End Users: **NO**
- Modern web browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, Brave, Opera) ship with **native WebGL 2.0 and WebAssembly runtime engines** out of the box.
- Players do not need to install plugins, drivers, runtimes, or extensions—visiting a hosted URL (e.g., itch.io) runs the game immediately in an HTML5 canvas.

### For Developers / C++ Builders: **YES**
Just as Desktop OpenGL requires local compilers (MinGW GCC/Clang), GLFW headers, and GLAD loader generators, compiling C++ into WebGL 2.0 requires a specialized WebAssembly cross-compilation toolchain:
1. **Emscripten SDK (`emsdk`)**: Cross-compiler drivers (`emcc`, `em++`).
2. **LLVM & Clang WebAssembly Backend**: Compiles C++17/20 source code into WebAssembly (`.wasm`) bytecode.
3. **Binaryen (`wasm-opt`)**: WebAssembly code optimizer and dead-code stripper.
4. **Embedded Node.js & Python**: Powers the Emscripten compilation pipeline.
5. **Local HTTP Server**: Bypasses browser CORS security restrictions when testing locally.

---

## 2. Package Architecture (`webgl_setup_script/`)

The package mirrors the structure and technical depth of `D:\GitHub\[personal]\opengl_setup_script`:

```plaintext
webgl_setup_script/
├── install_webgl_admin.bat        # 1-Click self-elevating setup script
├── uninstall_webgl_admin.bat      # Clean uninstaller (removes PATH & toolchain)
├── test_webgl_env.bat             # Diagnostic tool for compiler & environment
├── README.md                      # Overview & Quick Start guide
├── guide.md                       # Comprehensive WebGL & Emscripten manual
│
├── Dependencies/
│   ├── server/
│   │   └── run_local_server.bat   # 1-Click local HTTP preview server (CORS bypass)
│   └── template/
│       ├── include/
│       │   └── Common.h           # Unified header for GLES3, GLFW3, and WebAssembly
│       ├── src/
│       │   └── main.cpp           # Standard boilerplate WebGL 2.0 entry point
│       ├── shell_minimal.html     # Responsive HTML5 canvas & loader template
│       ├── Makefile               # GNU Make build script
│       └── build.bat              # Turnkey Windows build and preview script
│
├── PROJECTS/
│   └── create_webgl_project.bat   # Interactive project scaffolder
│
└── sample_projects/
    ├── Lab0_WebGL_ClearScreen/    # Minimal clear screen demo
    ├── Lab1_WebGL_Triangle/       # Modern RGB triangle (VAO/VBO/GLSL 3.00 ES)
    └── Lab2_WebGL_2D_Game_Sprite/ # 2D game sprite, Web Audio, asset packaging
```

---

## 3. Key Components & Capabilities

### ⚡ 1-Click Self-Elevating Installer (`install_webgl_admin.bat`)
- Automatically requests administrative elevation via VBScript UAC wrapper.
- Clones or downloads `emsdk` to `C:\emsdk`.
- Provisions and activates the latest LLVM wasm backend, Clang, Binaryen, and Node.js.
- Registers `C:\emsdk` and `C:\emsdk\upstream\emscripten` to Machine `PATH`.
- Automatically configures `EM_CACHE=C:\emsdk\cache` as a system variable, preventing the Windows cross-drive Python path bug (`ValueError: path is on mount 'C:', start on mount 'D:'`).

### 🔍 Diagnostic Tool (`test_webgl_env.bat`)
- Validates Git, Python, and Node.js availability.
- Verifies `em++` compiler detection.
- Compiles and links a live WebAssembly test binary to confirm LLVM and Binaryen function without errors.

### 🛠️ Interactive Scaffolder (`PROJECTS\create_webgl_project.bat`)
- Prompts for project name (e.g. `SpaceInvaders_Web`).
- Scaffolds a complete project folder with `src/`, `include/`, `assets/`, `shell_minimal.html`, `Makefile`, and `build.bat`.
- Automatically customizes the HTML title and canvas attributes.

### 🚀 Progressive Sample Labs (`sample_projects/`)
1. **`Lab0_WebGL_ClearScreen`**:
   - Demonstrates GLFW3 context creation on an HTML5 canvas.
   - Binds C++ render ticks to the browser's `requestAnimationFrame` loop using `emscripten_set_main_loop()`.
   - Dynamic oscillating color clear.
2. **`Lab1_WebGL_Triangle`**:
   - Modern WebGL 2.0 rendering pipeline with `#version 300 es` shaders.
   - Vertex Array Objects (VAO) and Vertex Buffer Objects (VBO).
   - Smooth RGB vertex color interpolation.
3. **`Lab2_WebGL_2D_Game_Sprite`**:
   - Interactive 2D player physics (movement, velocity, and gravity).
   - Keyboard handling via GLFW (`A`/`D`/Arrow keys and `Space`/`W` to jump).
   - HTML5 Web Audio API bridge via `EM_JS` synthesizing retro jump and land sound effects without external audio libraries.
   - Asset packaging into virtual memory filesystem using `--preload-file assets`.

### 📚 Comprehensive Documentation
- **`README.md`**: Badges, Quick Start, architecture breakdown, itch.io packaging, and uninstallation steps.
- **`guide.md`**: Complete technical manual detailing Desktop vs. WebGL differences, non-blocking browser event loops, GLSL ES 3.00 precision qualifiers, MEMFS virtual filesystems, Web Audio autoplay policies, and local CORS workarounds.

---

## 4. How to Initialize the New Repository

To turn `webgl_setup_script` into its own standalone Git repository:

```bash
cd webgl_setup_script
git init
git add .
git commit -m "Initial commit: WebGL 2.0 & WebAssembly 1-Click Setup Package"
git branch -M main
git remote add origin https://github.com/<your-username>/webgl_setup_script.git
git push -u origin main
```

31: ## 1. Executive Summary & Architectural Roadmap
32: 
33: **The Wenderer** was engineered as a high-performance, native desktop C++17 platformer utilizing hardware-accelerated Modern OpenGL 3.3 Core and Windows-native multimedia subsystems (`winmm.lib` for audio and Media Foundation for intro video decoding).
34: 
35: To make the game **playable online in modern web browsers** (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari, Opera) and publishable on **itch.io** without requiring players to download an `.exe`, we compile the C++ codebase to **WebAssembly (`.wasm`)** and **JavaScript (`.js`)** using the **Emscripten SDK (`emsdk`)**.
36: 
37: WebAssembly executes at near-native speeds in the browser sandbox, while OpenGL 3.3 draw calls translate directly into **WebGL 2.0** (which corresponds to OpenGL ES 3.0).
38: 
39: ```
40: +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
41: |                            THE WENDERER ENGINE (C++17)                            |
42: +-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
43: |             DESKTOP BUILD               |                WEB BUILD                |
44: |               (Windows)                 |         (Emscripten / WebAssembly)      |
45: +-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
46: | Compiler: g++ / MSVC                    | Compiler: em++ (Emscripten)             |
47: | Window:   GLFW 3.3 (Desktop Win32)      | Window:   GLFW 3.3 (Emscripten Port)    |
48: | Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 Core + GLAD        | Graphics: WebGL 2.0 (GLES 3.0 / gl3.h)  |
49: | Shaders:  #version 330 core             | Shaders:  #version 300 es               |
50: | Loop:     Blocking while(!glfwClose)    | Loop:     emscripten_set_main_loop()    |
51: | Audio:    WinMM (MCI mciSendStringA)    | Audio:    Web Audio API / HTML5 Audio   |
52: | Video:    Media Foundation (mfplat.lib) | Video:    HTML5 <video> / Direct Splash |
53: | Files:    Direct OS Filesystem          | Files:    MEMFS Virtual Asset Pack      |
54: | Storage:  score_record.txt (Disk)       | Storage:  Browser localStorage / IDBFS  |
55: +-----------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
56:                                                        |
57:                                                        v
58:                                             +--------------------+
59:                                             |      itch.io       |
60:                                             |  Browser Playable  |
61:                                             |     HTML5 Game     |
62:                                             +--------------------+
63: ```
64:

916: ## 9. Common Pitfalls, Web Autoplay & Debugging Cheat Sheet

918: ### 1. Browser Autoplay Policy (No Audio on Startup)
919: - **Symptom**: Game loads and runs, but background music and sound effects do not play.
920: - **Cause**: Modern browsers (Chrome, Safari, Edge) block audio context instantiation until a user interaction (mouse click or keypress) occurs within the document.
921: - **Fix**: *The Wenderer* starts on the Academic Splash Screen where players must press `Space`, `Enter`, or click to proceed. Hook audio initialization to this first key/click event.
922: 
923: ### 2. High-DPI / Retina Blurriness
924: - **Symptom**: Pixel art looks slightly blurry on 4K or MacBook Retina screens.
925: - **Fix**: The CSS rule in `shell_minimal.html`:
926:   ```css
927:   canvas.emscripten {
928:       image-rendering: pixelated;
929:       image-rendering: crisp-edges;
930:   }
931:   ```
932:   ensures nearest-neighbor scaling. Additionally, keep `initFbW` and `initFbH` locked to `1024x720` rather than scaling canvas internal resolution.
933: 
934: ### 3. Out-of-Memory / Heap Growth
935: - **Symptom**: Browser tab crashes with `Cannot enlarge memory arrays. Either (1) compile with -sALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1...`.
936: - **Fix**: Ensure `-sALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1` is present in the `em++` command line.
937: 
938: ### 4. Arrow Keys and Space Scrolling the Web Page
939: - **Symptom**: Pressing Space or Down Arrow scrolls the itch.io webpage down while playing.
940: - **Fix**: In `shell_minimal.html`, attach a key listener that calls `e.preventDefault()` for game keys:
941:   ```javascript
942:   window.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
943:       if(["Space", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight"].indexOf(e.code) > -1) {
944:           e.preventDefault();
945:       }
946:   }, false);
947:   ```

### 4. Arrow Keys and Space Scrolling the Web Page
- **Symptom**: Pressing Space or Down Arrow scrolls the itch.io webpage down while playing.
- **Fix**: In `shell_minimal.html`, attach a key listener that calls `e.preventDefault()` for game keys:
  ```javascript
  window.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
      if(["Space", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight"].indexOf(e.code) > -1) {
          e.preventDefault();
      }
  }, false);
  ```

### 5. itch.io Error: "Failed to find index.html"
- **Symptom**: itch.io upload fails with:
  > *There was a problem loading your project: Failed to find index.html. Please try deleting the file and uploading another one.*
- **Root Cause**: Windows Explorer's "Compress to ZIP file" was applied to the outer folder (`TheWenderer_Web`) rather than the files inside it. When compressed this way, the zip archive contains `TheWenderer_Web/index.html` instead of having `index.html` at the root of the archive.
- **Fix**: 
  1. Open `TheWenderer_Web/`.
  2. Select all 4 files inside (`index.html`, `index.js`, `index.wasm`, `index.data`).
  3. Right-click ➔ **Compress to ZIP file** (or directly use the automated [`TheWenderer_Web/TheWenderer_Web_itch.zip`](/TheWenderer_Web/TheWenderer_Web_itch.zip) generated by `build_web.ps1`, which already has `index.html` at the archive root).

### 6. Game Appears Stuck on "RUNNING" / Tutorial Modal / 404 on Audio
- **Symptom**: Game loads, browser title bar says `... | RUNNING`, but the game appears frozen or logs:
  `Quarter_in_the_Slot.mp3:1 GET .../assets/Quarter_in_the_Slot.mp3 404 (Not Found)`
- **Root Cause**:
  1. **Tutorial Window Modal**: On initial launch, *The Wenderer* opens the interactive tutorial window. While active, the engine pauses gameplay ticks (`deltaTime = 0.0f`). Until dismissed, the title says `RUNNING` while waiting for player input.
  2. **Iframe Canvas Focus**: Web games on itch.io run inside an `<iframe>`. The canvas cannot receive keyboard events until the player clicks inside the game window.
  3. **Virtual Filesystem vs. HTTP**: All game assets are bundled inside `index.data` (Emscripten's in-memory MEMFS). Calling standard DOM `new Audio("assets/Quarter_in_the_Slot.mp3")` attempts an HTTP network request to itch.io's server, which fails with 404.
- **Fixes Applied**:
  1. **In-Memory Audio Blobs (`src/Audio.cpp`)**: Audio playback now reads raw bytes directly from MEMFS using `FS.readFile(path)` and converts them to an in-memory `blob:` URL, completely eliminating network 404 errors.
  2. **Click-to-Focus & Auto-Resume (`shell_minimal.html`)**: Added automatic focus locking and audio context resuming on any canvas click or keydown.
  3. **Mouse Click Modal Dismissal (`src/main.cpp`)**: Left-clicking anywhere on the screen now immediately dismisses the tutorial modal and starts the game loop.

### 7. Harmless Console Warnings on itch.io
- **Logs**:
  ```text
  Unrecognized feature: 'monetization'
  Unrecognized feature: 'xr'
  Allow attribute will take precedence over 'allowfullscreen'
  Error with Permissions-Policy header: ...
  itch.io/html-callback:1 Failed to load resource: net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT
  ```
- **Explanation**: These are benign warnings from itch.io's hosting environment and ad-blockers:
  - `monetization` and `xr` are standard Permissions-Policy attributes included by itch.io for WebXR/Coil monetization.
  - `html-callback: ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT` is triggered when browser privacy extensions (e.g. uBlock Origin) block itch.io's analytics beacon. None of these affect game execution.

1. **Itch.io Web Port Guide**:
   - Provide a comprehensive technical and actionable deployment guide for porting *The Wenderer* into a web game playable online on itch.io.
   - Document in [`/doc/WEB_PORT_AND_ITCH_GUIDE.md`](/doc/WEB_PORT_AND_ITCH_GUIDE.md).
2. **Execute Full Web Build**:
   - Refactor codebase for cross-platform WebAssembly/WebGL 2.0 while maintaining 100% desktop compatibility.
   - Compile and package release bundle and zip ready for itch.io upload in [`/TheWenderer_Web/`](/TheWenderer_Web/).
3. **WebGL 1-Click Setup Package (`webgl_setup_script/`)**:
   - Answer whether WebGL requires installation similar to `D:\GitHub\[personal]\opengl_setup_script`.
   - Create a localized, turnkey repository folder `webgl_setup_script/` in project root and add it to `.gitignore`.
   - Implement self-elevating admin installer/uninstaller, diagnostic test tool, boilerplate templates, project scaffolder, and 3 progressive sample projects.
4. **Resolve itch.io Upload & Runtime Errors**:
   - Resolve `"Failed to find index.html"`.
   - Resolve `"Quarter_in_the_Slot.mp3 404 (Not Found)"` and game appearing stuck on `"RUNNING"`.

---

## 3. Engineering & Architecture Deliverables

### A. Core Engine WebGL 2.0 & WebAssembly Adaptation

# Resolution: itch.io "Failed to find index.html" & Console 404 Errors

Here is the exact breakdown of why these two issues occurred, the fixes implemented, and how to update your itch.io project with the updated build.

---

## 1. Why Did itch.io Show "Failed to find index.html"?

### The Root Cause:
When zipping a folder using Windows Explorer's standard right-click (e.g. right-clicking the folder `TheWenderer_Web` ➔ **Compress to ZIP file**), Windows places the **entire folder** inside the archive:
```plaintext
# ❌ INCORRECT ARCHIVE STRUCTURE:
TheWenderer_Web.zip
└── TheWenderer_Web/          <-- Subfolder created by Windows Explorer
    ├── index.html            <-- itch.io cannot find it here!
    ├── index.js
    ├── index.wasm
    └── index.data
```
itch.io's server inspects only the **root level** of the `.zip`. Because `index.html` was nested inside `TheWenderer_Web/`, itch.io reported:
> *"Failed to find index.html. Please try deleting the file and uploading another one."*

### The Fix:
`index.html` must sit directly in the root of the archive:
```plaintext
# ✅ CORRECT ARCHIVE STRUCTURE:
TheWenderer_Web_itch.zip
├── index.html                <-- Located at archive root
├── index.js
├── index.wasm
└── index.data
```
The automated script has packaged this properly for you in [`TheWenderer_Web/TheWenderer_Web_itch.zip`](/TheWenderer_Web/TheWenderer_Web_itch.zip).

---

## 2. Why Did the Console Show 404 for `Quarter_in_the_Slot.mp3`?

### The Root Cause:
In Emscripten, all game assets (`assets/*`) are bundled inside the **`index.data`** virtual in-memory filesystem (MEMFS).
In `Audio.cpp`, the web audio bridge previously called:
```javascript
window.g_bgm = new Audio("assets/Quarter_in_the_Slot.mp3");
```
The browser's native DOM `new Audio(...)` does not know about Emscripten's in-memory filesystem; it treats `"assets/Quarter_in_the_Slot.mp3"` as an HTTP network request to itch.io's CDN (`https://html-classic.itch.zone/.../assets/Quarter_in_the_Slot.mp3`). Because itch.io only hosts the 4 uploaded root files, it returned `404 (Not Found)`.

### The Fix in [`src/Audio.cpp`](/src/Audio.cpp):
The audio bridge now reads the raw audio bytes directly from Emscripten's virtual filesystem (`FS.readFile(path)`), wraps them into a browser `Blob`, and creates an in-memory `blob:` object URL:
```javascript
var bytes = FS.readFile(path);
var blob = new Blob([bytes], { type: 'audio/mpeg' });
var blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
window.g_bgm = new Audio(blobUrl);
```
- It loads directly from RAM.
- Zero network requests to itch.io CDN.
- Eliminates the 404 error entirely.

---

## 3. Why Did the Game Appear Stuck on "RUNNING"?

### The Root Cause:
1. **Interactive Tutorial Modal Window**: On startup, *The Wenderer* opens the tutorial modal window. While this modal is active, the engine intentionally pauses delta-time ticks (`deltaTime = 0.0f`). The window title bar and itch.io player status say `... | RUNNING` because the game engine is active and waiting for player input to dismiss the modal.
2. **Iframe Canvas Focus**: Games on itch.io run inside an `<iframe>`. Browsers do not route keyboard strokes to the canvas until the player **clicks inside the game container** to give it focus.
3. **Browser Autoplay Policy**: Modern browsers block audio until the first click or keypress.

### Improvements Applied:
- **Left-Click Modal Dismissal ([`src/main.cpp`](/src/main.cpp))**: Clicking anywhere on the canvas now automatically dismisses the tutorial modal (in addition to `Space`, `Enter`, `Esc`, or `T`).
- **Auto-Focus & Audio Resume ([`shell_minimal.html`](/shell_minimal.html))**: Added event listeners on `click`, `keydown`, and `touchstart` to focus the canvas and resume `AudioContext` instantly.
- **WebGL 2.0 GLFW Hints ([`src/main.cpp`](/src/main.cpp))**: Ensured `GLFW_CLIENT_API, GLFW_OPENGL_ES_API` with major 3, minor 0 under Emscripten.

---

## 4. Understanding the Other Console Messages

The remaining logs in your browser console:
```text
Unrecognized feature: 'monetization'
the-wenderer:12 Unrecognized feature: 'xr'
Allow attribute will take precedence over 'allowfullscreen'
Error with Permissions-Policy header: ...
itch.io/html-callback:1 Failed to load resource: net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT
```
- **Permissions-Policy (`monetization`, `xr`)**: These are standard HTTP headers generated by itch.io's hosting server (for WebXR and Web Monetization). Browsers that do not support those APIs simply log a harmless informational notice.
- **`net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT`**: Caused by an ad blocker or privacy extension (e.g. uBlock Origin) blocking itch.io's internal analytics tracking beacon. It does not affect game performance.

---

## 5. How to Update on itch.io (2 Steps)

1. **Delete the Old File on itch.io**:
   - Go to your itch.io project dashboard ➔ **Edit game**.
   - Under **Uploads**, click the trash/delete icon next to your old upload.

2. **Upload the Updated ZIP**:
   - Upload [`TheWenderer_Web/TheWenderer_Web_itch.zip`](/TheWenderer_Web/TheWenderer_Web_itch.zip) (this file has `index.html` at the archive root and the in-memory audio fix).
   - Check the box: ☑ **"This file will be played in the browser"**.
   - Under **Embed options**:
     - Viewport dimensions: **1024** width × **720** height.
     - Frame options: ☑ **Enable fullscreen button** and ☑ **Automatically start on page load**.
   - Click **Save & View Page**.
   - Click inside the game window to begin playing with full audio and controls.
